scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit To Scheduled Tribes
other_conditions: Must be an adult belonging to Scheduled Tribe community of Gujarat.
Must provide income proof and caste certificate with the application.
Must keep the birds safe during night hours and provide immediate treatment if they get infected.
Must maintain the unit for two years and present income and expenditure statements during officer visits.
benefits_summary: Provides a 25 R.I.R. bird unit and poultry feed subsidy covering up to 75% of the unit cost (maximum ₹4500).
